Package com.hkust.marketplace.repositories

Class ReviewRepository

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.repositories.ReviewRepository
public class ReviewRepository extends Object
MySQL persistence and read queries for seller reviews in the reviews table.

Supports admin moderation and search, seller-facing review history, replies, flags, and hiding/unhiding. Review rows are joined to deals and listings for usernames and listing titles.

      public List<Review> findAll() throws SQLException
      All reviews, newest first (includes hidden/flagged rows for the admin moderation screen).

    • findByRating

      public List<Review> findByRating(int rating) throws SQLException
      Reviews with exactly the supplied rating; ratings are constrained to 1..5.

      Uses a new connection and includes hidden/flagged rows.

      Parameters:

      Returns:

    • searchReviews

      public List<Review> searchReviews(String keyword, LocalDate from, LocalDate to) throws SQLException
      Admin search: literal keyword in the seller username (case follows the database collation) plus an inclusive created-date range. Null keyword/dates are ignored.

      Uses a new connection and includes hidden/flagged rows.

      Parameters:
      keyword - seller-username substring to find, or null/blank for no keyword
      from - inclusive earliest created date, or null for unbounded
      to - inclusive latest created date, or null for unbounded
      Returns:
      matching reviews, newest first; never null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when from is after to
      SQLException - when the query fails
      See Also:
      • searchReviews(String, Integer, LocalDate, LocalDate)

    • searchReviews

      public List<Review> searchReviews(String keyword, Integer rating, LocalDate from, LocalDate to) throws SQLException
      Same search with an optional exact rating (1..5) filter, for the ratings screen.

      Uses a new connection and includes hidden/flagged rows.

      Parameters:
      keyword - seller-username substring to find, or null/blank for no keyword
      rating - exact rating filter, or null for every rating
      from - inclusive earliest created date, or null for unbounded
      to - inclusive latest created date, or null for unbounded
      Returns:
      matching reviews, newest first; never null
      Throws:

      SQLException - when the query fails

    • findBySeller

      public List<Review> findBySeller(Connection connection, String seller) throws SQLException
      Seller-facing list excludes reviews hidden by an administrator.

      Caller-owned connection: this method never commits, rolls back or closes it. Reviews are matched through the deal's seller username and only rows with hidden = FALSE are returned.

      Parameters:
      connection - an open connection; the caller owns its lifecycle
      seller - the seller username
      Returns:
      the seller's visible reviews, newest first; never null
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • findBySellerForUpdate

      public Review findBySellerForUpdate(Connection connection, String seller, String reviewId) throws SQLException
      Returns one review belonging to the seller while locking it with FOR UPDATE.

      Caller-owned connection: this method never commits or closes it. Hidden reviews are not filtered out here.

      Parameters:
      connection - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; it is not closed
      seller - the seller username that must own the review
      reviewId - the review ID
      Returns:
      the locked review, or null when it does not exist or belongs to another seller
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • create

      public void create(Connection connection, String id, String dealId, int rating, String comment) throws SQLException
      Inserts one review row.

      Caller-owned connection: this method never commits or closes it. No rating or comment validation and no deal/order check is performed here; those belong to the service.

      Parameters:
      connection - an open connection; the caller owns its lifecycle
      id - the review ID to store
      dealId - the reviewed deal
      rating - the rating value to store
      comment - the review text, possibly null
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the insert fails

    • findForModeration

      public Review findForModeration(Connection connection, String reviewId) throws SQLException
      Locks and returns a review for an admin moderation decision.

      Caller-owned connection: this method never commits or closes it. The row is read with FOR UPDATE, and hidden/flagged state is included.

      Parameters:

      reviewId - the review ID

      SQLException - when the query fails

    • hide

      public boolean hide(String reviewId, Boolean hidden) throws SQLException
      Toggles a review's visibility: stores the opposite of the supplied current hidden state.

      Callers pass the review's current hidden value, so false hides the review and true unhides it. Uses a new connection and commits immediately; the row is updated by ID even when it is already in the target state.

      Parameters:
      reviewId - the review whose visibility is toggled
      hidden - the review's current hidden state; the stored value becomes !hidden
      Returns:
      true when a review row was updated, false when the ID does not exist
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when reviewId is blank
      SQLException - when the update fails

    • setHidden

      public boolean setHidden(Connection connection, String reviewId, boolean hidden) throws SQLException
      Sets a review's hidden flag to the supplied absolute value.

      Caller-owned connection: this method never commits or closes it. Unlike hide(String, Boolean) the value is not inverted.

      Parameters:
      connection - an open connection; the caller owns its lifecycle
      reviewId - the review to update
      hidden - the value to store
      Returns:
      true when a review row was updated, false when the ID does not exist
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the update fails
